trends.title: Cat Counter Surfing: End the Destruction Without Losing Your Mind
trends.quote: You need to choose which cat you want re-homed because I can't deal with this anymore.
trends.quote_context: A cat owner describes her boyfriend's ultimatum after their cat repeatedly knocked his belongings off the kitchen counter. The cat was labeled 'destructive' despite exhibiting completely normal feline behavior.
trends.pain_point: Cat constantly knocks items off counters, causing property damage, relationship tension, and owner frustration. Unsure how to redirect the behavior without rehoming.

scoring.uniqueness_notes: No existing skeleton for counter-surfing specifically. Related to indoor-cat-boredom-fix but distinct problem.
scoring.solvability_notes: Environmental management + redirection training + making counters unappealing = highly solvable

pillars.pillar: Understand WHY cats knock things off
pillars.evidence: Hunting instinct, attention-seeking, curiosity, prey drive. Well-documented feline behavior.
Remove items from counters, use deterrents, create cat-friendly alternatives elsewhere.

pillars.pillar: Redirect and retrain with positive reinforcement
pillars.evidence: Play sessions before tempting times, alternative hunting outlets, reward desired behavior.

existing_collisions.reason: Both address cat indoor enrichment but counter-surfing is a specific unwanted behavior, not general boredom

trends.title: Twin Toddler Sleep: Surviving the 2-Year-Old Sleep Regression
trends.quote: I have 28-month-old twin boys and I feel like I'm drowning right now. They are wonderful boys, but they are incredibly difficult to manage right now.
trends.quote_context: Mother of 28-month-old twins expresses complete overwhelm with managing both children during a sleep regression phase. Sleep deprivation affects entire family unit.
trends.pain_point: Parents of twins ages 2-3 experiencing sleep regression, overtiredness, and inability to manage both children's schedules simultaneously. Double the resistance, double the exhaustion.

scoring.uniqueness_notes: Slight overlap with new-parent-exhaustion and toddler-sleep-regression-survival. Twins-specific angle not directly covered.
scoring.solvability_notes: Twin-specific timing strategies, sibling-proofing sleep, handling twin sleep conflicts

pillars.evidence: Getting twins on overlapping schedules reduces total exhaustion window. Evidence from twin parenting communities.
Twin parents share triage strategies but limited formal research.

pillars.pillar: Regressions at 2 years: what's normal and how to respond
pillars.evidence: Two-year sleep regressions are documented. Separation anxiety and increased independence-seeking are typical.

existing_collisions.reason: Covers general new parent exhaustion but not twin-specific challenges
Covers sleep regression but not the unique twin management angle

trends.title: First-Time Homeowner Plumbing Emergency: What to Fix First
trends.quote: The inspection found several issues that are pushing me toward tackling the plumbing first: multiple leaks (including a shower leak), an old furnace condensate drain line that needs repair, original cast iron and galvanized drain pipes, and a sewer camera inspection that found significant root intrusion with an obstruction farther down the line.
trends.quote_context: First-time homeowner receives home inspection report with multiple plumbing issues. Overwhelmed trying to understand what needs immediate attention vs. what can wait.
trends.pain_point: First-time homeowners receive home inspection reports with multiple plumbing issues and don't know how to prioritize repairs. Cast iron pipes, root intrusion, leaks - all mentioned but no context on urgency or cost.

scoring.uniqueness_notes: Overlap with foundation-repair-cost-shock and plumbing-emergency-budget. Plumbing-specific angle partially covered.
scoring.solvability_notes: Guide could prioritize issues by urgency and cost. Some problems require professional - limits DIY content.

pillars.pillar: Understanding pipe materials and their failure risks
pillars.evidence: Cast iron and galvanized pipes have known lifespans and failure modes. Well-documented in plumbing literature.

pillars.pillar: Root intrusion: severity assessment and options
pillars.evidence: Root intrusion severity determines solution (snaking vs. hydro-jetting vs. pipe replacement).

pillars.pillar: Prioritizing repairs by urgency and cost
pillars.evidence: General guidance exists but specific prioritization depends on local codes and contractor input.

existing_collisions.reason: Covers plumbing emergencies and budget planning but not specifically inspection prioritization
Both are new homeowner panic guides but cover different systems

summary.notes: Cat counter-surfing is the clear winner. Twins guide has slight collision risk but unique angle. Plumbing guide overlaps with existing content.
